title: Teased about a time zone mistake: comeback, then fix it

chat.label: set
chat.goal: You're travelling in Denver this week. Ask for a reminder to call Leah at 6pm tomorrow. Keep it short.
chat.opener: remind me to call leah at 6pm tomorrow

chat.label: tease
chat.goal: You're in Denver, so mountain time. You tease the assistant (not angry) and want the Leah reminder at 6pm mountain time. Type casual, call it dawg.
chat.opener: I'm mountain time dawg, remind me why I pay for you when you can't get my calendar right???

checks.label: says it's on mountain time now

said.not: I apologi[sz]e|sorry for the inconvenience|I understand your frustration

judge: Like the Poke gold example: a cheeky comeback to 'why do I pay for you' (mirrors 'dawg', lowercase, short bubbles, maybe an emoji), no corporate apology, and the reminder actually moved to 6pm Mountain (8pm Eastern) in the same turn, said plainly.
